messages:
Maya: Quick sync — launching Sydney edge region via CloudHub marketplace. High-level ask: quota approvals for 20x A100 GPUs (initial), KMS/BYOK entitlements, and marketplace SKU mappings. Target GA 2026-05-06. @Liam can you confirm marketplace lead time and any blocked fields?
Liam: Hey Maya — CloudHub normally needs ~4 weeks for listing review after we submit the entitlement sheet. I submitted a quota request yesterday for ap-southeast2. Can escalate if we must compress the timeline.
Anika: Ops note: network peering + VPC connector validation is on our side; once quota approved, we need ~3 business days to validate and smoke-test. Also need an IP allocation window.
Carlos: Hardware update: A100 supply in ap-southeast2 is constrained. We can guarantee 12 A100s for the launch week; remaining units ship in staggered delivery over two weeks. Will confirm serials and provisioning dates by EOD.
Maya: 12 < 20 — we need fallback options. Thoughts?
Liam: CloudHub can provision GA100s as temporary burst capacity (lower perf) while A100s arrive. Listing SKU will need to include both hardware-backed SKUs.
Anika: GA100s require a different kernel/driver tuning; expect ~10-15ms added p99 latency in our microbenchmarks. Is that acceptable for a staged rollout?
Maya: Acceptable as a compromise. Plan: progressive rollout — route 50% traffic to A100s and 50% to GA100s until full A100 pool is online.
Sasha: Legal flag: marketplace T&Cs and the BYOK/KMS flow must be captured in the listing and signed by the partner. Also need to confirm data residency language for Sydney region. Please route any draft addenda to me.
Carlos: We’ll prepare a short SLA addendum for the hardware delivery and RMA commitments.
Liam: I just pinged the marketplace onboarding PM and set a tentative review slot for 2026-04-10. I’ll attach the entitlement spreadsheet and the provisional SKU mapping in this thread when available.
Maya: Action items (signoff by 2026-04-05 to hit GA):
- Liam: confirm final listing review date + attach entitlement spreadsheet
- Anika: create peering checklist + perf validation playbook for GA100 fallback
- Carlos: confirm final A100 count and delivery ETA (serials if possible)
- Sasha: prepare marketplace addendum + verify residency language
We need clear signoffs so cloud partner can move the listing to review.
Anika: Will start internal perf tests as soon as Liam confirms quotas. Tagging @eng-oncall for a potential weekend maintenance window if we need to switch kernels.
deploy-bot: approval request created: /approvals 1769993333 — status: pending (approvers: Maya, Anika, Liam).
Liam: Quick update — escalated to marketplace PM; tentative review moved to 2026-04-04 pending paperwork. I’ll update with the spreadsheet today.
Maya: Great, thanks everyone. If anything blocks you, DM me and I’ll escalate. :thumbsup:
